decisions.reason: Retaining horizontal scrolling on the mobile pricing table changes only its responsive layout; it does not change the required itemized services, detailed breakdown, or pricing transparency.
The mobile pricing-table layout decision does not change the homepage pricing link or its detailed-pricing destination.
Horizontal scrolling affects mobile presentation only and leaves the package count, square-footage categories, pricing matrix, and package prices unchanged.
The responsive pricing-table layout decision does not alter the one-time pricing model or the removal of monthly and annual tabs.
The source pricing-layout decision does not change gallery hover behavior; the separate animation clause in the same message is already represented by the candidate's message-76 events.
Retaining the current mobile pricing layout does not change the destinations of the homepage Gallery, Pricing, and Services buttons.
The mobile pricing-table decision has no effect on the homepage design direction, image emphasis, or blue overlay.
The pricing-table layout decision does not alter gallery scrolling, gallery tabs, or secondary gallery organization.
Retaining horizontal scrolling for mobile pricing does not modify the sitewide requirement for an image-focused visual design.
The mobile pricing-table layout decision does not change the requirement to associate each listed service with a relevant image.
The source Event concerns the mobile pricing table, while the message's animation clause resolves gallery hover effects rather than the independently defined homepage gallery animation.
The mobile pricing-table presentation decision does not modify or resume the deferred quote calculator or any of its calculation rules.
